summary: cli_parse with ansible.utils.xml runs a command returning XML, like show interface | xml, and converts it in one task using xmltodict.
questions: How do I parse XML output from a network device?

answer_card.title: Parse XML output
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- ansible.utils.cli_parse:
    command: show interface | xml
    parser:
      name: ansible.utils.xml
  register: interfaces
```
Runs the command and converts the XML to native data in a single task (support covers `xmltodict` public APIs).
